**Race Masters** TAG: a fan-made 3D mod built on the Top Gear SNES Port by thebradshaw (https://github.com/thebradshaw/topgear-pc).

**You need your own Top Gear (USA) SNES ROM.** No ROM or game data is included: the game's code runs from your copy, and its graphics, sound and music are read from it. Unzip, run `race-masters-launcher`, choose your ROM, set the options and press Start.

Downloads:
- **Windows (x64):** `race-masters-windows-x64.zip`
- **Linux (x64, experimental):** `race-masters-linux-x64.tar.gz`. It's built automatically and hasn't been tested on real Linux machines yet, so it may not be stable. Please report what you find.

What's in it: the port's races drawn in real 3D (F7 switches to the original picture), plus the port's optional extras: widescreen, a full-screen 1-player view, smooth motion and high frame rate, a ghost car, auto-save, display filters, TV colours, rumble and button remapping. The title screen shows the main keys; the options menu (Tab) has them all.

**Optional modern music:** the launcher's **Build music** makes modern versions of the game's music on your computer, from your own ROM: the seven songs in three styles and every city's tune in four, 149 tracks. It downloads about 1.2 GB of free instruments once and takes about half an hour to an hour; you can play meanwhile. No music is included in the downloads.

The README has the details; LEGAL.md and the `licenses` folder list the components and their licences.

A fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Kemco, Gremlin Graphics or any other rights holder. Top Gear is a trademark of its owners and is named here only to say which game this works with.
